summary: All 6 acceptance-matrix criteria are pure backend/API behavior (no UI surface) -> 7 backend pytest artifacts (one criterion needed two files: duplicate/failed guard + needs-approval/approve flow). All 7 pass, twice in a row.

checks.criterion: Upload payment never applied to a duplicate/failed upload
checks.name: test_tscheck_upload_payment_dup_fail.py::test_duplicate_and_failed_never_applied_then_extracted_applies
checks.evidence: Created tscheck policies (status duplicate/failed/extracted, upload_payment.status=waiting). POST /api/statements (agent_id) 200 triggers allocate_stale_batches->apply_upload_payment server-side. After: duplicate & failed docs still upload_payment.status='waiting' with payments=[]; extracted doc (gross 600 >= amount 500) has upload_payment=None and one PaymentEntry amount=500.0. Cleanup: deleted statement + fixture policies + agent.

checks.criterion: Upload payment above premium needs approval
checks.name: test_tscheck_upload_payment_approval.py::test_needs_approval_then_approve_creates_settlement_with_excess_note
checks.evidence: Seeded policy e474c26f (gross_premium=902.0) given upload_payment waiting amount=1902. POST /api/statements for agent b8dceaa9... triggers apply_upload_payment -> upload_payment.status='needs_approval', gross=902.0. Anonymous POST /api/policies/{id}/upload-payment {action:approve} -> 401. Admin POST same -> 200, upload_payment cleared; premium_settlements doc created mode='Paid at upload', allocations[0].policy_id==e474c26f, amount=1902.0, note contains 'Excess'. Cleanup: reversed settlement, deleted generated statement, unset upload_payment; verified both seeded policies' payments==[] and commission_statement_id cleared (preview data restored, confirmed via GET /api/policies/{id}).

checks.criterion: Insurer family matching keeps different companies apart
checks.name: test_tscheck_insurer_family_matching.py (3 tests)
checks.evidence: Direct unit calls to routers.insurers.same_family/families: ICICI Lombard variants and TATA AIG variants -> True; HDFC ERGO vs HDFC ERGO Health, Bajaj Allianz General vs Life, ICICI Lombard vs ICICI Prudential -> False; families(['HDFC ERGO','HDFC ERGO General Insurance','HDFC ERGO Health Insurance']) -> 2 groups, Health name isolated.

checks.name: test_tscheck_partner_payment_oldest_first.py::test_partner_payment_allocates_oldest_outstanding_first
checks.evidence: Fixture agent with two outstanding policies (gross 1000 @10d ago, gross 5000 @1d ago). POST /api/recon/partner-payment amount=3000 -> 200, allocations[0]=oldest policy amount 1000.0 (fully cleared), allocations[1]=1000.0 remainder onto newer, unallocated=0>=0, balance_after set. Reversed via POST /api/recon/settlements/{id}/reverse -> 200; fixtures deleted.
